title: Professional Certificate Course in Supervisory Structure of the International Banking Institutions and Markets
description: In this course learners will explore the complex world of international banking institutions and markets.
longDescription: The Professional Certificate Course in Supervisory Structure of International Banking Institutions and Markets is designed to provide a comprehensive understanding of the global financial system. This course covers key topics such as international financial markets, institutions, and regulations, the impact of globalization on the shadow banking system, institutions affecting lending and banking regulations, and international agreements regarding banking and finance. Upon completion, students will thoroughly understand the supervisory structure of international banking institutions and markets.
